jobs.name: 长廊窗口
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE complete CellDefense top-down biological tower-defense MAP BACKGROUND, not a poster, not a UI screenshot, not a montage.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the exact CURRENT GAME ART STYLE reference ONLY. Keep its warm peach/coral tissue floor, discreet broad epithelial cell impressions, chunky hand-painted pixel contours, pale cream collagen borders, rounded salmon tissue lobules, dark raspberry wound floors, and familiar compact teal-rimmed three-cell protected core. Do NOT retain its level layout.
INPUT IMAGE 2 is a checked 15-column by 11-row SPATIAL GUIDE, with bottom-left logical origin. Follow its placements and topology carefully, but translate every rectangle into soft, organic, rounded tissue geometry. Dark-gray cells indicate outer membrane and raised impassable tissue, beige indicates EMPTY WALKABLE / FREE-BUILD FLOOR, magenta is a real open wound entry, teal is the single protected core, and blue points are route-planning annotations to REMOVE. Any orange guide region is ONLY reserved flat floor for a FUTURE SEPARATE INFLAMMATION OVERLAY: do not paint an orange rectangle, boundary, warning, fire or active inflammation into this base image.
COMPOSITION: one full-canvas landscape map, approximately 15:11 aspect ratio (target 1800x1320); orthographic 90-degree top-down, no perspective, no dramatic height. The perimeter tissue band is compact, about one logical cell; keep most of the interior calmly open for freely placed units. Sparse rim decoration only. Maintain the current game's restrained pixel-brush texture with crisp stepped clusters; no noisy grain, no airbrush, no watercolor, no realistic wet flesh, no rendered 3D.
Each specified entrance is an actual open GAP cut completely through the perimeter to the IMAGE EDGE, with a flat magenta-to-coral wound FLOOR flowing into the arena. The cream border must STOP on both sides of the opening, never cross it. Do not seal the opening with a membrane thread or cell. No dark cave, no enclosed hole or door. Entrance mouth about 12–14% of image height. Other edges are intact with NO extra entrances.
Draw exactly ONE protected core at the EXACT POSITION specified for THIS map below, a small triangular cluster of THREE pale peach cells enclosed by ONE teal membrane, about 8–10% of image width. It is one target, not three separate cores. Leave open space all around it and room behind it. Never connect an obstacle or perimeter directly to the core.
Fixed obstacles are clearly raised, cream-collagen-rimmed peach tissue islands, distinguished from the very flat, low-contrast floor. Keep safe, readable open clearances; their rounded outlines should respect the guide footprints. Floor patches are decor ONLY and must not look like extra obstacles.
NO towers, tower sockets, circles for tower positions, enemies, arrows, blue dots, navigation roads, painted lanes, grid lines, text, titles, numbers, HUD, buttons, legend, watermark, sci-fi equipment, rocks, grass, or decorative colored nodes. The final image contains only biological terrain, the specified wound entries, obstacle islands and the one core.
MAP 2-3 — LONG CONTACT WINDOW / A CURVING ENGAGEMENT CORRIDOR.
Exactly TWO open LEFT EDGE wounds: PRIMARY entry at y=40.9% from image top, SECONDARY entry at y=77.3%. The secondary opening is real terrain and not sealed; later activation is handled by gameplay, do not draw a gate.
One protected teal three-cell core centered at x=83.3%, y=50%.
Exactly TWO detached elongated tissue islands, staggered a little more closely than the previous two-line map:
A upper-middle footprint x=26.7–40%, y=18.2–54.5%;
B lower-middle footprint x=53.3–66.7%, y=45.5–81.8%.
The main left approach passes BELOW A, then curves ABOVE B, creating a long visible contact space between the two shapes. Preserve broad continuous buildable floor to the side of this implicit curving route, especially below A and above B, where sampling, marking and assembly units can support a wall at different stages. The two islands stay detached and do not form a pinhole. The lower secondary approach joins this contested middle section; units invested there compete with forward assembly investment. Keep a substantial recovery clearing between the second island and the core. No road paint, no symbolic tower lineup, no enemies.
